# Commands

Every `mt` command, grouped by area the way `mt help` lists them. In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command:
`mt app-list`. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on its own. `mt help <command>`
shows a command's arguments and options in your terminal, and its entry here shows the same.

Installing `mt`, signing in, namespaces, output and exit codes: [The mt command line](../index.md).

## Agents

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`agent-create`](agents.md#agent-create) | Create an agent from a model, a system prompt and a summary (with no tools: deploy a project for those) |
| [`agent-delete`](agents.md#agent-delete) | Delete an agent (refused while an interaction or router uses it, or a live run needs it) |
| [`agent-get`](agents.md#agent-get) | Show an agent by name: its latest version, how many tools it has, and its id |
| [`agent-list`](agents.md#agent-list) | List the agents in a namespace (every namespace when none is set) |
| [`agent-update`](agents.md#agent-update) | Change an agent: only what you give changes, the rest is kept from its latest version (a new version when anything differs) |

## AI models

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`aimodel-list`](ai-models.md#aimodel-list) | List the AI models agents can run on, with their names and ids |

## API keys

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`api-key-create`](api-keys.md#api-key-create) | Create an API key and show how to use it, once (needs a sign-in with an email address and password, not an API key) |
| [`api-key-delete`](api-keys.md#api-key-delete) | Disable one of your API keys, so it no longer signs in (needs a sign-in with an email address and password, not an API key) |
| [`api-key-list`](api-keys.md#api-key-list) | List your API keys: name, dates and id, never the secret (needs a sign-in with an email address and password, not an API key) |

## API management

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`api-login`](api-management.md#api-login) | Sign in with an API key or an email address and password, and save the sign-in (checked with the API first) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`api-url-get`](api-management.md#api-url-get) | Show the API URL commands use (MAITENTO_BASE_URL overrides the saved one) |
| [`api-url-set`](api-management.md#api-url-set) | Save the API URL commands use (MAITENTO_BASE_URL, when set, overrides it) *(not in the cloud shell)* |

## Apps

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`app-attach`](apps.md#app-attach) | Attach to an app run and follow it until it ends (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`app-delete`](apps.md#app-delete) | Delete an app (refused while it has live runs or an automation starts it) |
| [`app-get`](apps.md#app-get) | Show an app by name: its latest version, number of inputs and id |
| [`app-list`](apps.md#app-list) | List the apps in a namespace (every namespace when none is set) |
| [`app-patch-inputs`](apps.md#app-patch-inputs) | Change input values of a live app run, as `--input-<name>` (the app reads them the next time it asks) |
| [`app-ps`](apps.md#app-ps) | List the live app runs in a namespace, oldest first |
| [`app-run`](apps.md#app-run) | Run an app and wait for it to end; inputs as `--input-<name>` (exits 1 if the run ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`app-start`](apps.md#app-start) | Start an app without waiting for the run to end; inputs as `--input-<name>` |

## Automated actions

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`action-create`](automated-actions.md#action-create) | Create an automation from a JSON array of actions; add its schedules and triggers afterwards |
| [`action-delete`](automated-actions.md#action-delete) | Delete an automation and its schedules and triggers, by `--name` or `--id` (at once, with no `--confirm`) |
| [`action-get`](automated-actions.md#action-get) | Show an automation by `--name` or `--id`: how many schedules and triggers it has, and when it next runs |
| [`action-history`](automated-actions.md#action-history) | List the runs an automation started, newest first: when, what triggered it, the outcome and any error |
| [`action-list`](automated-actions.md#action-list) | List the automations in a namespace |
| [`action-msg-trigger-add`](automated-actions.md#action-msg-trigger-add) | Add a message trigger to an automation: start it when an app, interaction or capsule run changes and matches a filter |
| [`action-msg-trigger-disable`](automated-actions.md#action-msg-trigger-disable) | Switch off a message trigger of an automation, without removing it |
| [`action-msg-trigger-enable`](automated-actions.md#action-msg-trigger-enable) | Switch a message trigger of an automation back on |
| [`action-msg-trigger-remove`](automated-actions.md#action-msg-trigger-remove) | Remove a message trigger from an automation |
| [`action-msg-trigger-update`](automated-actions.md#action-msg-trigger-update) | Change a message trigger of an automation: its name, type or filter (only what you give changes) |
| [`action-schedule-add`](automated-actions.md#action-schedule-add) | Add a schedule to an automation: a cron expression in fields, in UTC (a field left out means every) |
| [`action-schedule-disable`](automated-actions.md#action-schedule-disable) | Switch off a schedule of an automation, without removing it |
| [`action-schedule-enable`](automated-actions.md#action-schedule-enable) | Switch a schedule of an automation back on |
| [`action-schedule-remove`](automated-actions.md#action-schedule-remove) | Remove a schedule from an automation |
| [`action-schedule-update`](automated-actions.md#action-schedule-update) | Change a schedule of an automation: its name or cron fields (only what you give changes) |
| [`action-trigger`](automated-actions.md#action-trigger) | Run an automation now, without waiting for a schedule or trigger (prints the id of the first run it starts) |
| [`action-update`](automated-actions.md#action-update) | Replace an automation's name, description and actions (its schedules and triggers are kept) |

## Build

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`build`](build.md#build) | Validate a project folder: compile and check every file, and save nothing *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`build-delete`](build.md#build-delete) | Delete a build's record from the build history; what it deployed is untouched (tenant admins only) |
| [`build-get`](build.md#build-get) | Show one build or deploy from the build history: who ran it, how it ended, and its compilation log |
| [`build-list`](build.md#build-list) | List recent builds and deploys (the build history), newest first, in a namespace or in every namespace with `--all` |
| [`deploy`](build.md#deploy) | Deploy a project folder: compile and check every file, then save it all to the namespace (tenant admins only; nothing is saved if any file has an error) *(not in the cloud shell)* |

## Capsules

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`capsule-add-user`](capsules.md#capsule-add-user) | Add a Linux user to a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-command-await`](capsules.md#capsule-command-await) | Wait for a command in a capsule run to finish and show its result (exits 1 if it fails, times out or the run ends first) |
| [`capsule-command-get`](capsules.md#capsule-command-get) | Show the status and output of a command in a capsule run |
| [`capsule-delete`](capsules.md#capsule-delete) | Delete a capsule definition (refused while it has live runs or an automation starts it) |
| [`capsule-exec`](capsules.md#capsule-exec) | Queue a command in a live capsule run and print its id, without waiting for it (follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-get`](capsules.md#capsule-get) | Show a capsule definition and one of its versions: template, packages, users, mounts and startup commands |
| [`capsule-history`](capsules.md#capsule-history) | List capsule runs, live and ended, newest first (of one capsule when named, else of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`) |
| [`capsule-install-package`](capsules.md#capsule-install-package) | Install a Debian package in a live capsule run, with apt (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-list`](capsules.md#capsule-list) | List the capsule definitions of every namespace, or of one with `--namespace` |
| [`capsule-mount-secret`](capsules.md#capsule-mount-secret) | Mount a secret as a file at /mnt/secrets/&lt;mount-name> in a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-mount-vfs`](capsules.md#capsule-mount-vfs) | Mount a file system at /mnt/&lt;mount-name> in a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-ps`](capsules.md#capsule-ps) | List the live capsule runs in a namespace, oldest first |
| [`capsule-remove-package`](capsules.md#capsule-remove-package) | Remove a package from a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-remove-user`](capsules.md#capsule-remove-user) | Remove a Linux user from a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-start`](capsules.md#capsule-start) | Start a capsule and print the run's id without waiting for it (a capsule is a short-lived Linux sandbox) |
| [`capsule-terminate`](capsules.md#capsule-terminate) | Terminate a live capsule run (queued: the run ends shortly after) |
| [`capsule-unmount-secret`](capsules.md#capsule-unmount-secret) | Unmount a secret from a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |
| [`capsule-unmount-vfs`](capsules.md#capsule-unmount-vfs) | Unmount a file system from a live capsule run (queued: follow it with capsule-command-await) |

## Code pipelines

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`code-pipeline-answer`](code-pipelines.md#code-pipeline-answer) | Answer a question a code pipeline run is waiting on |
| [`code-pipeline-attach`](code-pipelines.md#code-pipeline-attach) | Follow a code pipeline run until it ends: status, phases, steps and questions as they happen (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`code-pipeline-delete`](code-pipelines.md#code-pipeline-delete) | Delete a code pipeline (refused while it has live runs or an automation starts it) |

| [`code-pipeline-run`](code-pipelines.md#code-pipeline-run) | Run a code pipeline and follow it until it ends: status, phases, steps and questions as they happen (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`code-pipeline-start`](code-pipelines.md#code-pipeline-start) | Start a run of a code pipeline's latest version (inputs as `--input-<name>`; repositories and credentials from a request file) |

| [`code-pipeline-update-credentials`](code-pipelines.md#code-pipeline-update-credentials) | Replace the AI credentials a live code pipeline run uses, from a local JSON file (the run carries on) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`code-pipeline-update-repos`](code-pipelines.md#code-pipeline-update-repos) | Replace a live code pipeline run's repositories and their git credentials, from a local JSON file (the run carries on) *(not in the cloud shell)* |

## Connectors

| [`connector-delete`](connectors.md#connector-delete) | Delete a connector by name, without asking for `--confirm` (refused while a tool is built on it) |
| [`connector-get`](connectors.md#connector-get) | Show a connector by name: its type, latest version, authentication, URL and id |
| [`connector-list`](connectors.md#connector-list) | List the connectors in a namespace (every namespace when none is set) |

## Credentials

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|

| [`credential-delete`](credentials.md#credential-delete) | Delete a model credential and take it out of every credential stack (tenant admins only) |
| [`credential-get`](credentials.md#credential-get) | Show a model credential: its endpoint, keys by hint (never the keys) or sign-in, models and health |

| [`credential-stack-get`](credentials.md#credential-stack-get) | Show a credential stack and its entries in the order they're tried, with each entry's rules |
| [`credential-stack-list`](credentials.md#credential-stack-list) | List the tenant's credential stacks (the ordered credentials a run may use), marking the tenant's default |
| [`credential-test`](credentials.md#credential-test) | Test a model credential's keys without running a model and show each result (exits 1 if it fails; tenant admins only) |

## File system

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`batch-edit`](file-system.md#batch-edit) | Edit several files of a file system at once, from a JSON file of edits (all or nothing unless `--not-atomic`) |
| [`batch-read`](file-system.md#batch-read) | Print several files of a file system at once (exits 1 if any cannot be read) |
| [`cat`](file-system.md#cat) | Print a file's text, from your disk or a file system |
| [`cd`](file-system.md#cd) | Change the working directory, which relative paths start from |
| [`cp`](file-system.md#cp) | Copy a file or directory, also between your disk and a file system (overwrites existing files) |
| [`edit`](file-system.md#edit) | Edit a file in a file system: find and replace text, replace or delete lines, or insert after a line |
| [`exists`](file-system.md#exists) | Check whether a file or directory exists in a file system (exits 1 if it does not) |
| [`find`](file-system.md#find) | Find files in a file system by a glob pattern on their path, by their text, or both |
| [`ls`](file-system.md#ls) | List the files and directories in a directory (ls /vfs lists your file systems) |
| [`mkdir`](file-system.md#mkdir) | Create a directory, and any parent directories it needs |
| [`mv`](file-system.md#mv) | Move or rename a file or directory, also between your disk and a file system (copies it, then deletes the source) |
| [`rm`](file-system.md#rm) | Delete a file, or a directory and everything in it (there is no confirmation) |
| [`tree`](file-system.md#tree) | Show a directory of a file system, and everything below it, as a tree |
| [`write`](file-system.md#write) | Write text to a file in a file system, replacing it or adding to its end (its directory must exist) |

## Files

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`file-delete`](files.md#file-delete) | Delete a file from its knowledge base, by id (there is no confirmation; tenant admins only) |
| [`file-download`](files.md#file-download) | Download a knowledge file's original content to your disk (tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`file-get`](files.md#file-get) | Show a knowledge file: its name, type, size and whether it is indexed yet, by id (tenant admins only) |
| [`file-get-by-checksum`](files.md#file-get-by-checksum) | Find an uploaded knowledge file by the MD5 checksum of its content (tenant admins only) |
| [`file-search`](files.md#file-search) | Search a knowledge base for the passages closest in meaning to a query |
| [`file-text`](files.md#file-text) | Print the text extracted from a knowledge file: what search and agents read (tenant admins only) |
| [`file-update`](files.md#file-update) | Replace a knowledge file's content with a file from your disk, keeping its id (tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`file-upload`](files.md#file-upload) | Upload a file from your disk to a knowledge base, to be read and indexed (tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |

## Getting started

| Command | What it does |

| [`interaction-get`](interactions.md#interaction-get) | Show an interaction by name: its kind, latest version and id |

## Looms

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`loom-create`](looms.md#loom-create) | Create a loom in a namespace |
| [`loom-cut`](looms.md#loom-cut) | Let a thread go: its words are released, and a knot keeps its essence and why it was let go |

| [`loom-give`](looms.md#loom-give) | Give a thread to another loom: it arrives second-hand, saying where it came from (only shared knowledge travels) |
| [`loom-inspect`](looms.md#loom-inspect) | Inspect a loom: its shape, what is held close, what is fraying, tensions and the last night weaving |
| [`loom-list`](looms.md#loom-list) | List the looms in a namespace |
| [`loom-night-spend`](looms.md#loom-night-spend) | Show the night weavings of every loom in the tenant since a moment, with what each one spent |
| [`loom-night-weave`](looms.md#loom-night-weave) | Ask for a loom to be night-woven now, without waiting for the quiet period |
| [`loom-panels`](looms.md#loom-panels) | Show a loom's panels: the portrait in prose night weaving writes of each person or thing the loom knows |
| [`loom-pattern`](looms.md#loom-pattern) | Show the pattern a loom keeps of a codebase, or shape it (how it is built, how to find your way, where to start, its conventions) |
| [`loom-pattern-delete`](looms.md#loom-pattern-delete) | Erase the whole pattern a loom keeps of a codebase; to drop one item, use loom-pattern `--remove` (tenant admins only) |
| [`loom-patterns`](looms.md#loom-patterns) | List the patterns a loom keeps: the shape of each codebase its agents work in, and when each last changed |
| [`loom-pin`](looms.md#loom-pin) | Hold a thread close, so it is in every future tapestry, or release it with `--release` |
| [`loom-recall`](looms.md#loom-recall) | Recall the threads that matter for a question, most relevant first (looking does not strengthen them) |
| [`loom-reflect`](looms.md#loom-reflect) | Show everything a loom holds about a topic (foundations, what was woven across them, tensions, what was let go, and how understanding moved) |
| [`loom-reframe`](looms.md#loom-reframe) | Reframe a thread with new wording, weight or foundational status; a seam keeps what it was and why it changed |
| [`loom-seed`](looms.md#loom-seed) | Seed a loom from another: copy in the strongest of its shared knowledge, each thread marked as inherited |
| [`loom-sessions`](looms.md#loom-sessions) | List agents' recent sessions with a loom (who, in which interaction run, when, and whether night weaving has consolidated them) |
| [`loom-tapestry`](looms.md#loom-tapestry) | Show what an agent would wake up knowing: the tapestry woven for the people present |
| [`loom-tension-resolve`](looms.md#loom-tension-resolve) | Resolve an open tension, saying how: the loom keeps the resolution, and neither thread is changed |
| [`loom-tensions`](looms.md#loom-tensions) | Show a loom's open tensions, threads pulling against each other (`--all` includes resolved ones) |
| [`loom-thread`](looms.md#loom-thread) | Show one thread in full: what it says, its standing, where it came from, how it changed, and how it has been used |
| [`loom-threads`](looms.md#loom-threads) | List a loom's threads, filtered and sorted as you choose (by default newest first, without knots) |
| [`loom-unravel-thread`](looms.md#loom-unravel-thread) | Erase (unravel) one thread, with any tension and panel derived from it, for data-subject erasure; to let a thread go and keep a knot, use loom-cut (tenant admins only) |
| [`loom-update`](looms.md#loom-update) | Rename a loom, or change its description or night-weaving settings (only what you give changes) |
| [`loom-weave`](looms.md#loom-weave) | Weave a thread into a loom (a near-duplicate reinforces the existing thread instead) |
| [`loom-weavings`](looms.md#loom-weavings) | Show a loom's night weavings: what each night consolidated, and the dream log it wrote |

## Namespaces

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`namespace-create`](namespaces.md#namespace-create) | Create a namespace |
| [`namespace-delete`](namespaces.md#namespace-delete) | Delete an empty namespace (refused, listing what is left, while it holds anything) |
| [`namespace-get`](namespaces.md#namespace-get) | Show a namespace by name: its id and when it was created |
| [`namespace-list`](namespaces.md#namespace-list) | List the namespaces in the tenant |
| [`namespace-update`](namespaces.md#namespace-update) | Rename a namespace |
| [`ns-get`](namespaces.md#ns-get) | Show the default namespace commands use (MAITENTO_NAMESPACE overrides the saved one) |
| [`ns-set`](namespaces.md#ns-set) | Save the default namespace commands use when given no `--namespace` (MAITENTO_NAMESPACE, when set, overrides it) |

## Notifications

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`notifications`](notifications.md#notifications) | Watch live updates to runs and knowledge files as they happen, until you stop it (Ctrl+C) |

## Partitions

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`embedding-model-list`](partitions.md#embedding-model-list) | List the embedding models a knowledge base can be indexed with, and their widths (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-create`](partitions.md#partition-create) | Create a knowledge base (a partition; tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-delete`](partitions.md#partition-delete) | Delete an empty knowledge base, by id (delete its files first; tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-credentials-clear`](partitions.md#partition-embedding-credentials-clear) | Remove a knowledge base's own embedding keys and its consent to fall back to Maitento's key (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-credentials-set`](partitions.md#partition-embedding-credentials-set) | Replace a knowledge base's own embedding keys and fallback consent, from a JSON file on your disk (tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`partition-embedding-failure-acknowledge`](partitions.md#partition-embedding-failure-acknowledge) | Mark a knowledge base's embedding key failures as seen (the key stays blocked until replaced; tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-failure-list`](partitions.md#partition-embedding-failure-list) | List the knowledge bases whose own embedding keys have failed, one row per failure (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-probe`](partitions.md#partition-embedding-probe) | Test an embedding model with your keys and show the width it returns (exits 1 if it fails; tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`partition-embedding-profile-set`](partitions.md#partition-embedding-profile-set) | Set the embedding model a knowledge base is indexed with; a change of index needs `--allow-reindex` (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-stack`](partitions.md#partition-embedding-stack) | Show the credential stack a knowledge base embeds with, or change it with `--set` or `--clear` (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-embedding-status`](partitions.md#partition-embedding-status) | Show a knowledge base's embedding model and index state, with any re-index's progress (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-file-list`](partitions.md#partition-file-list) | List a knowledge base's files, newest first, a page at a time (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-get`](partitions.md#partition-get) | Show a knowledge base's name, id and creation date, by id (tenant admins only) |
| [`partition-list`](partitions.md#partition-list) | List the tenant's knowledge bases (partitions; tenant admins only) |

## Processes

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`kill`](processes.md#kill) | Kill a live run, by its type and id (final: the run ends as Killed and cannot be resumed) |
| [`process-list`](processes.md#process-list) | List runs of every type, live and ended, newest first (of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`) |
| [`process-summary`](processes.md#process-summary) | Show an overview of a namespace's recent runs: counts by type and state, live runs, recent failures and tokens used |
| [`ps`](processes.md#ps) | List the live runs of every type in a namespace (apps, interactions, capsules and code pipelines) |
| [`retention-get`](processes.md#retention-get) | Show how long the tenant's runs are kept after they end, and how many runs it retains against its limit |
| [`run-release`](processes.md#run-release) | Release a run kept with run-retain, and the runs it kept, so the tenant's retention applies again |
| [`run-retain`](processes.md#run-retain) | Keep a run, and every run it started, past the tenant's retention until you release it (for at most your plan's longest retention) |

## Secrets

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`secret-create`](secrets.md#secret-create) | Create a secret: a named value, such as an API token, that definitions refer to by name |
| [`secret-delete`](secrets.md#secret-delete) | Delete a secret by name, without asking for `--confirm` |
| [`secret-get`](secrets.md#secret-get) | Show a secret's name, id and dates (never its value) |
| [`secret-list`](secrets.md#secret-list) | List the tenant's secrets: names, ids and dates (never their values) |
| [`secret-update`](secrets.md#secret-update) | Change a secret's value, its name, or both |

## Usage

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`usage-breakdown`](usage.md#usage-breakdown) | Show a range's usage grouped by one dimension, such as namespace, definition, model or agent, largest first |
| [`usage-runs`](usage.md#usage-runs) | List the runs behind a range's usage, the most tokens first (or by runtime, execution or date) |
| [`usage-series`](usage.md#usage-series) | Show one usage measure over time, in hour, day or week buckets, optionally split by a dimension |
| [`usage-summary`](usage.md#usage-summary) | Show a range's usage totals (runs, tokens, runtime) beside the range before it, and by outcome |

## Verbose logging

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`verbose-get`](verbose-logging.md#verbose-get) | Show whether verbose logging (mt's own debug logs) is on |
| [`verbose-set`](verbose-logging.md#verbose-set) | Turn verbose logging on or off: mt writes its own debug logs to the console, from the next time it starts |

## Virtual file systems

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`vfs-create`](virtual-file-systems.md#vfs-create) | Create an empty file system in a namespace |
| [`vfs-destroy`](virtual-file-systems.md#vfs-destroy) | Delete a file system and every file in it (there is no confirmation) |
| [`vfs-get`](virtual-file-systems.md#vfs-get) | Show a file system by name: its id, status and where it is mounted |
| [`vfs-list`](virtual-file-systems.md#vfs-list) | List the file systems in a namespace |
| [`vfs-sync`](virtual-file-systems.md#vfs-sync) | Mirror a directory on your disk into a file system, creating it if needed (adds, overwrites and deletes to match) *(not in the cloud shell)* |

## Web access

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`web-access-get`](web-access.md#web-access-get) | Show the default knowledge base for web downloads, the tenant's or a namespace's with `--namespace` (where runs keep the web pages their agents read) |
| [`web-access-set`](web-access.md#web-access-set) | Set or clear the default knowledge base for web downloads, the tenant's or a namespace's with `--namespace` (tenant admins only) |

## Web hooks

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`webhook-delete`](web-hooks.md#webhook-delete) | Delete a webhook, by `--id` or by `--type` and `--url` |
| [`webhook-delivery-list`](web-hooks.md#webhook-delivery-list) | List a webhook's recent deliveries, newest first: delivered, retrying or failed, and why (delivered ones are kept 24 hours, failures 7 days) |
| [`webhook-get`](web-hooks.md#webhook-get) | List the tenant's webhooks: the type, URL and id of each |
| [`webhook-set`](web-hooks.md#webhook-set) | Register a webhook, or update the one already registered for the same type and URL |

## Shell

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`help`](shell.md#help) | List the commands, or show how to use one |

## In the interactive shell

The interactive shell (`mt` on its own) and the cloud shell handle these themselves. They mean nothing to a
single `mt` command.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `clear` | Clear the screen |
| `exit` | Close the shell |
